newsitem.title: INDIA: India castorseed March prices steady amid protests.
newsitem.headline: India castorseed March prices steady amid protests.

text.p: India's castorseed March delivery prices held steady at a reduced level of 1,157/1,159 rupees per quintal on Tuesday amidst protests by traders over a new daily clearing exercise, dealers said.
"Operators and brokers have decided not to trade in the newly opened June delivery as they are protesting against the imposition of daily clearing by exchange authorities," one dealer said.
"No trade in the June delivery has affected trading volumes for the March delivery."
Sentiment was subdued on higher new crop arrivals and lower overseas buying. Daily arrivals of castorseed in the Gujarat region remained high at 35,000 bags (75 kg each).

Groundnut oil eased by 2/3 rupees to 338/340 rupees per 10 kg on sluggish physical buying and higher arrivals of imported edible oil, mainly palm oil and sunflower oil, at the Bombay port. Palm oil slid by 1/2 rupees to 280 rupees per 10 kg.
In Rajkot spot groundnut oil however was steady at 510/515 rupees per 15 kg. -- Bombay Commodities +91-22-265 9000
